description: Conditional Catholic answer cell for Q-MORAL-GROUNDING: absence of a due voluntarily controlled operation is classified as culpa by q.48 a.5 and as evil in the agent by the existing q.48 a.3 privation account. This is a typed conditional, not an existence cell for man-made evil. It leaves actual culpable operations, objective due-order standards, and divine permission unproved; no compatibility with all Catholic commitments or refutation of a rival follows. The strongest rival may grant this conditional but deny objective dues or voluntary control; alternatively an internal critic can grant both and challenge divine permission. Neither challenge is answered here.
